strategy: Manual stratification: reserve one answerable query from each single-document category plus the multi-policy query; isolate unanswerable queries from relevance tuning.
heldout_policy: W7-T2 must not execute or inspect retrieval/reranking results for heldout queries. They are reserved for W7-T3.
unanswerable_policy: Excluded from ordinary relevance tuning because they have no positive relevance labels.
